service.heading: SERVICE
service.description:
Connectrip Japan was born from a simple idea.
Japan is home to countless attractions beyond its world-famous sights — local culture, food and scenery that remain largely unknown.
Not because people aren't interested, but because language and cultural barriers keep them from ever making that connection.
Removing that barrier, and connecting travelers with regions, people with culture, to create genuine encounters with the real Japan — that is where Connectrip Japan begins.

faq.heading: FAQ
faq.subheading: Answers to the questions we hear most often — feel free to browse.

items.question: Can I consult in English?
items.answer: Yes. We support you in English from your initial inquiry through on-trip assistance.

items.question: Do you cover areas outside Kansai?
items.answer: Yes. We're based in Kansai, but we handle travel planning and arrangements across all of Japan.

items.question: How many days in advance should I get in touch?
items.answer: We recommend reaching out 3 to 6 months before your trip. We'll do our best to accommodate last-minute requests as well.

items.question: Can I use this service for a solo trip?
items.answer: Absolutely. We support everything from solo travelers to families and groups.

items.question: What's the difference between custom-made travel and a package tour?
items.answer: A custom-made trip is built from scratch around your wishes. A package tour follows a pre-set itinerary.

items.question: Can you help with places I found on TikTok or Instagram?
items.answer: Yes. Share the post's URL or a screenshot with us, and we'll check the details and guide you on how to add it to your itinerary and how to get there.

items.question: Can you also book restaurants and experiences?
items.answer: Yes, we support bookings for restaurants, cultural experiences, activities and more.

items.question: Is a private guide available?
items.answer: Yes, we offer private guide services centered on Osaka, Kyoto, Nara and Hyogo.

items.question: Can I request arrangements only, without a guide?
items.answer: Yes, we also accept requests for travel planning and arrangements only, without a guide.

items.question: Is it okay if I don't speak Japanese?
items.answer: No problem. We support you in English from before your trip through the entire journey, so you can travel with peace of mind.

seo.title: Cancellation Policy | Connectrip Japan
seo.description: Connectrip Japan's cancellation policy — consultation fees, cancellation fees after booking, and how refunds are handled.

cancelPolicy.heading: Cancellation Policy
cancelPolicy.intro:
Thank you for choosing Connectrip Japan.
To help you use our service with confidence, we have set out the cancellation policy below.
Please be sure to review it before booking.

sections.title: Travel Consultation & Planning Fee
sections.body:
We propose a fully custom-made travel plan for each and every customer.
To request a travel consultation, a deposit of 300 USD is required. Once the deposit is confirmed, we begin the consultation and plan-creation process.
If you go on to confirm your booking, the 300 USD deposit is deducted from your total travel cost.
If you use the consultation only and do not proceed to a booking, a consultation fee of 300 USD will be charged for any second or later consultation.
Up to two revisions to the plan are free of charge. From the third revision onward, an additional fee of 80 USD per revision applies.

sections.title: Cancellation After a Tour Is Booked
sections.body:
If you cancel after a hotel, transport, or experience reservation has been confirmed, you will be charged the cancellation fee set by the relevant facility or operator, in addition to our arrangement fee.
The refunded amount will be the total paid, less any cancellation fees, payment processing fees, and refund handling fees actually incurred.

sections.title: Cancelling a Private Guide or Package Tour
sections.body: The following cancellation fees apply, based on the tour start date.
sections.note: Actual costs for accommodation, transport, tickets, etc. are charged separately.

sections.title: Changing Your Itinerary
sections.body:
We will accommodate itinerary changes wherever possible.
However, if a change or cancellation fee is charged by an already-booked facility or transport provider, that cost will be borne by the customer.

sections.title: Cancellation on Our Part
sections.body:
If we are unable to provide the service due to natural disaster, transport suspension, government request, or other unavoidable circumstances, we will offer a rescheduled itinerary or a refund depending on the situation.
If we are unable to provide the service due to reasons attributable to us, we will refund the amount paid for the affected service.

sections.title: No-Show Cancellation
sections.body:
If we do not hear from you within 30 minutes of the agreed meeting time, this may be treated as a no-show cancellation.
In this case, no refund will be issued.

sections.title: Refund Method
sections.body:
Refunds are, in principle, issued to the original payment method used.
The time it takes for a refund to be processed varies depending on your credit card company or payment service.

sections.title: Contact Us
sections.body:
If you wish to cancel or make a change, please contact us as early as possible.
Messages received outside business hours will be handled on the next business day.
Cancellation fees are applied based on the date and time we confirm receipt of your message.

cancelPolicy.footerSignature: Connectrip Japan Inc. | This policy may be updated without prior notice.
